# World-Walker external projects and models

This repository packages pipeline orchestration and project-owned adapters. It does not vendor third-party repositories or distribute checkpoint weights. Configure external paths in `.env` or the ignored `configs/model_registry.local.yaml`. See `configs/external_repos.example.yaml` for upstream, revision and role records.

License names are reported only when found in an inspected local `LICENSE` file. Unknown or unverified terms remain marked `UNKNOWN`; do not treat a repository URL, model name, or open-source dependency as permission to redistribute weights. See [release_audit/third_party_licenses.md](../release_audit/third_party_licenses.md). The project's own license is still unselected; see [LICENSE_SELECTION_REQUIRED.md](../LICENSE_SELECTION_REQUIRED.md).
